description: He wears a long deep-blue open kaftan-like coat with narrow muted gold geometric embroidered borders and modest dark-brown fur-like trim at the collar and cuffs. A cream long shirt with maroon geometric embroidery at the neckline and lower edge shows beneath. Paired round gold-toned clasps fasten the upper coat, and a wide maroon-and-gold woven fringed sash ties around the waist with a long hanging end. Brown loose trousers tuck into tall brown boots. Fabrics appear wool-like over a linen-like shirt; exact fibers and fur material are uncertain. No headgear or weapon is present.
